bios.short: Technical Lead in Seattle, Washington, with 9+ years building enterprise software for hospitality, healthcare, travel, transport, finance, education and e-commerce.
bios.medium: I'm a Technical Lead with 9+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise software, and an MSc in Software Engineering. I've grown from Associate Software Engineer to Technical Lead at Apptimus Tech, where I now lead a team of 5–7 engineers building web and mobile platforms for hospitality, travel, transport, finance and education. I focus on solution architecture, AI-assisted engineering and mentoring the engineers I work with.

principles.title: Business-driven engineering
principles.description: Start from the business problem and the people who have it. Technology choices follow from what the business needs.

principles.title: Architecture with simplicity
principles.description: Prefer the simplest design that meets today's needs and can grow with tomorrow's. Complexity has to earn its place.

principles.title: Mentoring through collaboration
principles.description: Grow engineers by working alongside them: pairing, design reviews and shared ownership of hard problems.

principles.title: Continuous learning
principles.description: Keep learning as the tools change, including putting AI-assisted development and LLM integration to work where they genuinely help.

principles.title: Quality over complexity
principles.description: Readable code, sensible tests and clear documentation outlast clever solutions.

values.title: Ownership
values.description: Take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks, from design through to production.

values.title: Clear communication
values.description: Explain trade-offs in plain language to engineers, product owners and stakeholders alike.

values.title: Respect for users
values.description: Remember that every system serves real people doing real work.

values.title: Pragmatism
values.description: Choose what works for the team and the business over what's fashionable.
